name: OpenAI Codex
verdict: Codex is included with ChatGPT, and Plus at $20 is enough for a few focused coding sessions a week.
pros: Included with the ChatGPT plan you already pay for
Plus covers web, CLI, IDE, and iOS
cons: Allowances are ranges, not a fixed message count
Fast mode burns the included allowance at 2.5x
pricingNote: The pricing page gives local-message estimates per five hours for Plus, not fixed caps: GPT-6 Astra 5–45, GPT-6.1 Sol 15–160, GPT-6 Sol 15–150, GPT-6 Luna 350–3,000. Cloud tasks cost more of the same allowance, and weekly limits may also apply. Business and Enterprise share Codex, but this page does not list a Business dollar price.
